title: Don't waste your money, Thin. Awful.
text:
Don't waste your money, Thin. Awful.. A few years ago, I bought 45 pieces of Calphalon cookware (for my kids also). Mostly there Commercial line, that Calphalon does not make anymore..
The Simple use to be good, but now its Thin junk cookware, although this is a good size.

Calphalon recommends you hang there cookware, which I have done. Do not stack them on top of each other, if you do put a paper plate between them.
This cannot be hung as the hole in the handle is Small, and the Hole in the handle now has rubber in it!!..
All Calphalon Simple is made in China, and is very thin. You might as well buy cookware at Walmart for Less money.

product_metadata.title: Calphalon Simply Nonstick 5-qt. Sauté Pan & Cover
features: Nonstick interior for easy release and cleanup
Comfortable silicone handles stay cool on the stovetop
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Oven Safe upto 400° F , recommended stove tops: Gas, Electric, Halogen or Glass Stovetop , Utensils: Nylon, Coated or Wood
description: An ideal choice for cooking enthusiasts, Simply Calphalon Nonstick brings durability and performance to your kitchen. Its long-lasting nonstick surface consistently delivers delicious results followed by easy cleanup, while the hard-anodized aluminum construction promotes fast and even heating. Silicone handles feel comfortable and stay cool on the stovetop. The generously sized 5-qt. Saute Pan with Cover is perfect for preparing meats, vegetables, meat sauces and one-pan meals.
